title: Constitutive Models for Oscillatory Micellar Sedimentation
exact_target: Find a constitutive model that explains sustained oscillation of a sphere settling through a wormlike micellar fluid.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000875 (OWR-1736-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Theory and Numerics of Fluid-Solid Interaction (2007), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2007/53, pp. 3131--3180; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 11--12.

status_qualification: The target is the observed micellar sedimentation regime. The source gives no unique constitutive family, parameter identification, or mathematical oscillation criterion; importing a specific polymer model as the definition of success would narrow the question.
